text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... <chrname>'s traits at the current moment 
are... Since the environment will change 
at Longchamp—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops. Trainer <username>! Do you have a 
moment? During that SS Match, I had a 
sudden flash of inspiration..."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I've upgraded the VR Umalator to 
your specifications! Want to give it a 
spin right away?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"Hahaha. I'm the one who should be 
thanking you. ...Now, go and make the most 
of your special training on the simulated 
Longchamp!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I enter the prepared Umalator with <chrname>. Let's 
keep working hard towards the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe!
